Maharashtra Minister Announces Probe into Stamp Duty Process Irregularities

Maharashtra Minister Atul Bawankule announced that the Advocate General's office will investigate alleged irregularities in the stamp duty process. This announcement follows a report by the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) which flagged certain property transactions. The state government is currently working to recover deficient stamp duty identified in these transactions. The probe aims to address concerns raised regarding the proper collection of stamp duty.
